scope.scientific_question: Can the unchanged E*R_B gate and localizer selectively deploy frozen D2 on EN-confusion positions while suppressing its known correct-Mandarin damage?

frozen_intervention.gradient: autograd.grad through float32 zero leaf at current pre-FFN site; tangent projection and normalization float64; return float32

S1.dialogue_universe: the 20 dialogue IDs in the frozen positions artifact; equal dialogue weighting
S1.mode: independent same-state single pulse at frozen query; no earlier edits

broad_rule.total_squared_energy: sum(actual post-NormPreserve C2 edit norm squared) over the 180 frozen rows
broad_rule.solver: unchanged P2-R solve_scale, maximum 8 evaluations, solve effective scalar lambda on unit D2 axis; apply alpha=2, g=1, direction tensor=(lambda/2)*d_readout and verify actual hook energy after dtype rounding
broad_rule.direction_orientation: D2 axis only; scalar amplitude is the frozen energy-matching control
broad_rule.zero_C2_energy: set target to zero and C3 exactly no-edit; zero-vs-zero aggregate match is valid
broad_rule.unreachable_rows: retain row and count zero realized energy; overall C3/S1 invalid if aggregate tolerance fails

metrics: same C1 OLD-GATED margin/corruption summaries, descriptive only
E, R_B, g=E*R_B, realized edit energy: per-stratum median/IQR/fraction-positive

descriptive_ratios.r_benefit: C2 EN-confusion mean delta_m / matched ungated P2-DIR D2 mean delta_m; fixed denominator +4.499 nat
descriptive_ratios.r_harm: abs(C2 ZH-correct mean delta_m) / abs(matched ungated P2-DIR D2 mean delta_m); fixed denominator -2.011 nat

bootstrap.within_dialogue: mean positions first, then equal mean over dialogue IDs represented in that endpoint/stratum; absent dialogue-stratum cells are omitted from that draw denominator
bootstrap.decision_family: C2/C3 confusion margin (2), C2/C3 EN/ZH correct margins (4), paired C2-C3 confusion/ZH margins (2), C2/C3 EN/ZH corruption rates (4)
bootstrap.equivalence_interval: paired percentile 90% CI for C2-C3 only

selection.eligible_universe: all role-mapped eligible IDs in the existing P2-A D-dev-select parent panel, grouped by its frozen 20 dialogues
selection.algorithm: within each dialogue, first five sorted by (hex(SHA256(UTF8(tag+'|'+utterance_id))), utterance_id); emit dialogue IDs lexicographically

S2.reuse_B0: P2-A B0M_L16 only if exact 100 IDs, model/tokenizer, prompt, generation settings, and cached path match; otherwise generate in S2
S2.reuse_OLD: P2-A L16_a2_ER_id_pos only if exact 100 IDs and execution semantics/manifests match; otherwise generate in S2
S2.broad_rule: unchanged csasr.inference_cf.broad.BroadBudget: per-utterance Q_new from actual reference-free NEW squared edit energy and N from B0 UTF8-complete eligible queries; equal packet, actual-energy debit, cap/exhaustion, 2% aggregate and 5% per-utterance mismatch validity; Q_new=0 means exact no-edit; Q_new>0 with N=0 invalidates S2; if all Q_new are zero, BROAD is exact no-edit and zero-vs-zero is valid
S2.AUTO: reuse B0_AUTO only when exact compatible cached outputs and hashes exist; else omit, no GPU regeneration

uncertainty.interval: two-sided pointwise percentile 95%; sample 20 dialogue clusters with replacement and recompute corpus ratio from summed utterance-level numerators/denominators; recompute retention/outside-harm rates from sampled counts

audit.pre_run: CPU only; verify hashes, provenance, fixed population, exact joins, threshold freeze, data firewall and no outcome before PASS_TO_P2_SEL_S1
audit.post_run: independent auditor; must not import primary analysis/decision module; recompute population, gates/directions, realized energy, outcomes, bootstrap and labels

compute.planned_jobs: one S1; one conditional S2 only after audited rescue
